data.body: Decision 2026-09-29 (maintainer reviewed the evidence): Aworkit keeps running as a native Wayland client; window position is accepted as compositor-owned and will NOT be restored, and Aworkit must not be switched to XWayland (no forced GDK_BACKEND=x11) to gain positioning. Rationale: position is the platform's to decide on Wayland, and native rendering is preferred over the XWayland trade-off. Size restore (a7371de) and the honest empty position (0040fa2) stand. Revisit only if the maintainer asks for XWayland explicitly.
